'''June 2000 Milford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milford, MA on 10 June 2000. It is known from Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d873">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10d873/ milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-milford-mass-why-3a-will-save-me2k-6-10d873/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Milford, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
